people.name: Carlos Campos
people.bio:
Carlos Campos is a former Sacramento radio personality best known as co-host of the popular Monica and Carlos morning show. After beginning his broadcasting career as a teenager, he later transitioned into financial services and now works as a Market Growth Director in the Medicare space. A father of five and stepfather of three, Carlos is passionate about family, faith, travel, and building meaningful relationships through every season of life.

‍

people.name: Jeff Peel
people.bio: Jeff Peel is Chief Operating Officer at Alpha, where he supports partners through operations, integrations, and strategic execution. With a people-first approach, he focuses on building high-performing teams, improving patient experience, and creating systems that support sustainable growth. Prior to Alpha, Jeff held leadership roles at 24 Hour Fitness, Gold’s Gym, HearingLife, and Artemis Wax.

people.name: Sharon Benton
people.bio: Sharon Benton is the co-owner of Santa’s Enchanted Workshop, an immersive Christmas experience she created with her husband, Scott, after more than 20 years in the photography industry. Her work is centered on storytelling, creating meaningful family memories, and giving children a thoughtful, personalized Santa experience. She is also expanding the brand through Santa’s Enchanted Workshop Academy, where she plans to teach other photographers how to create the same kind of memorable experience for families.

people.name: Giovanni Antonello
people.bio: Giovanni “Gio” Antonello is an Army veteran, former law enforcement professional, husband, and father of three. After serving nine years in the military, including a 15-month deployment to Iraq, Gio faced years of addiction, self-sabotage, and personal loss before rebuilding his life through sobriety, honesty, and family. Today, he is studying to become a teacher and hopes to use the lessons from his past to help the next generation understand that failure does not have to be the end of the story.

people.name: Jessica York
people.bio:
Jessica York is Alpha’s Director of Operations, East Coast, serving as a key operational partner to practices across the region. She focuses on removing roadblocks, bringing structure to daily operations, and helping practices grow while maintaining a high standard of care. Jessica works closely with partners and clinic leaders to build strong teams, develop leaders, improve performance, and create environments where people are proud to work.

She oversees operations across multiple East Coast practices, helping drive alignment, consistency, profitability, and an elevated patient experience. Prior to joining Alpha, Jessica held roles at Best Buy, MyEyeDr., and Advanced MedAesthetic Partners. She brings eight years of experience as a Director of Operations, including three years in aesthetics, with a strong background in multi-site leadership and performance management.

‍

people.name: Rachel Coons
people.bio: Rachel Coons is a money coach, mom of four, fitness instructor, and host of The Money Mom Podcast. She helps women build healthier relationships with money by looking beyond budgets and spending habits to the beliefs, emotions, and patterns driving their financial decisions. Drawing from her own journey with money, marriage, and personal growth, Rachel empowers women to feel more confident, intentional, and at peace with their finances.

people.name: Karyss Bollen
people.bio: Karyss Bolin is the founder and owner of My Trendy Trailer, a Folsom-based boutique that grew from a farmers market booth and handmade jewelry line into a beloved local retail destination. What began as a personal journey to build creativity and confidence has become a brand centered on helping women feel beautiful, seen, and confident in their own style. Karyss is passionate about community, customer experience, family business, and creating a shopping environment that feels personal, welcoming, and authentic.

people.name: Alec Nethercott
people.bio: As a 40 Under 40 business leader and best-selling author, Alec inspires his audiences to take charge of their professional growth and reach their full potential. Whether you're looking to increase your sales, improve your management skills, or scale your team to new heights, Alec can help you. Drawing on his 17 years of experience in sales leadership, Alec equips leaders with the mindset, tools, and strategies to create lasting success.

people.name: Benjamin Hernandez
people.bio: Benjamin Hernandez is part of Skytale, a healthcare-focused investment banking, management consulting, and private capital firm. He works with founders, private equity groups, and healthcare businesses on growth strategy, M&A, diligence, and transaction support, with deep experience in the medical aesthetics space. Through Skytale’s work across more than 20 aesthetics deals, Benjamin brings a clear perspective on consolidation, valuation, private equity, and what makes a med spa business attractive to the right partner.

people.name: Holly Reininger
people.bio: Holly Reininger is a mother, advocate, and co-founder of Walk With Austin, a nonprofit dedicated to creating more inclusive play spaces and opportunities for children of all abilities. Inspired by her son Austin and her family’s experience navigating disability, accessibility, and rare disease, Holly works to educate communities, support families, and help build spaces where every child can participate. She is also a co-owner and coach at Push It, where she helps women build strength, confidence, and community.

people.name: Erin Wilkins
people.role: Registered Nurse, Educator, and Founder , Essentially Erin
people.bio:
Erin is a registered nurse, entrepreneur, professional babywearing educator, and intuitive living advocate dedicated to helping women feel informed, confident, and empowered in the choices they make for themselves and their families. As a wife and mother of five, she brings both professional knowledge and personal experience to conversations around motherhood, wellness, birth, family health, and intentional living.

Through her platform, Essentially Erin, she creates a supportive space for women seeking greater independence and confidence in body, mind, soul, and spirit. Her work encourages women to educate themselves, trust their intuition, and take ownership of both everyday decisions and life’s most meaningful choices.

people.name: Kassi Wertz
people.bio: Kassi Wertz is an athlete and advocate whose story reflects resilience, discipline, and purpose. Through her journey, she continues to inspire others with her commitment to growth, community, and the belief that challenge can become a source of strength. As part of Wembelieve, Kassi represents the spirit of perseverance and the power of using personal experience to encourage others.

people.name: Mark S. Allen
people.role: Film Producer / Director and TV person, Make The Movie LLC
people.bio: Mark S. Allen is an eight-time Emmy Award-winning television host, producer, filmmaker, and founding member of the Critics Choice Association. He first gained national attention as host of Short Attention Span Theater on Comedy Central, and later created and hosted the Emmy Award-winning Mark at the Movies on Reelz, followed by the syndicated series Extra Butter TV. He currently serves as executive producer and host of Take A Look, an entertainment program distributed internationally. Allen began his career alongside Lisa Ling on the syndicated show Scratch and has spent decades covering film and television, interviewing actors, filmmakers, and industry professionals across both studio and independent projects. As a filmmaker, he was recently inducted into the p.g.a, and has written, directed, and produced nine features, including APParition with Mena Suvari and Kevin Pollak, the comedy Ballbuster with Jerry O’Connell, and the MMA drama Notorious Nick. His credits also include Amy’s F It List, which received audience recognition at the Cannes World Film Festival.

people.name: Kristen Weckworth
people.bio:
Kristen is a real estate professional who values the relationships she builds with her clients and understands the impact that buying or selling a home can have on someone’s life. She is committed to guiding people through the process with care, clarity, and a personalized approach.

‍

people.name: Sarah Camarillo
people.bio: Sarah Camarillo is an influencer who shares her life, personal growth, and experiences openly on social media. She began her career doing makeup and worked with Chanel before transitioning into full-time content creation. Her journey includes undergoing a rhinoplasty that significantly impacted her confidence and how she shows up publicly. She is also a mother who created a local community group, the Folsom Moms Club, to bring women together through in-person meetups and walks. Sarah is open about her personal life, including the loss of her son to a rare genetic condition, and uses her platform to connect with others through vulnerability, faith, and shared experiences.

people.name: Andrea Beck
people.role: CMO, Partner at CMO Consulting Group | Fractional CMO at Alpha Aesthetics
people.bio: Andrea infuses entrepreneurial energy into company initiatives while harnessing her enthusiasm for progress with a passion for data analysis to drive informed decision-making. These qualities make Andrea an indispensable resource for both the scrappy startup and the established organization seeking new opportunities for aggressive growth. With 15 years of experience spanning multiple industries and disciplines, Andrea embraces a holistic approach to marketing management that underscores the importance of ensuring data hygiene, adopting the right technologies to plan, execute and measure campaign performance, and embracing a test program that empowers the organization to continually optimize across all customer touch-points. The past several years of consulting have offered Andrea many new avenues through which she can share her skill set with a multitude of companies who are eagerly seeking to embrace innovation and achieve their growth goals.

people.name: Riley Williams Haydock
people.role: Senior Manager, Partnership Marketing, Alpha Aesthetics Partners
people.bio: Riley Williams Haydock, a Senior Manager in Partnership Marketing, supports marketing program orchestration across various partners while currently working at Alpha Aesthetics Partners. Born and raised in the Capital Region, Riley graduated from Siena College in 2020 with a degree in Marketing and began a career in real estate shortly thereafter. With a passion for guiding clients in their buying and selling journeys, Riley enjoyed serving as a Licensed Real Estate Salesperson at Miranda Real Estate Group, Inc. from 2021 to 2023. Additionally, Riley has maintained a performance career with Riley Williams Acoustics since 2017, creating unique playlists and donating time to charitable organizations.

people.name: Stephanie Bettencourt
people.bio:
Stephanie B. is a mother and advocate who shares the story of her son Steven’s struggle with addiction in hopes of raising awareness about fentanyl, substance abuse, and the impact addiction has on families. Through speaking openly about her family’s experience, she encourages earlier conversations about drugs, reduces stigma around addiction, and supports other parents navigating similar challenges.

‍

people.name: Dr. Megan Falls Vincze
people.role: Fellowship-Trained Facial Plastic Surgeon, Esthetics Center.
people.bio: Dr. Megan Vincze is a fellowship-trained facial plastic surgeon at Esthetics Center. She completed her residency in Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery at Indiana University, followed by advanced fellowship training in facial plastic surgery and hair restoration. Dr. Vincze specializes in deep plane facelift and neck lift procedures, cosmetic and functional rhinoplasty, facial reconstruction, nonsurgical rejuvenation treatments, and hair restoration using FUE and FUT techniques. Known for her precision, patient-centered approach, and commitment to natural results, she brings both surgical expertise and thoughtful care to every patient she treats.

people.name: Drew Fine
people.role: Drew Fine is the U.S. General Manager, Obagi Medical
people.bio: Drew Fine is the U.S. General Manager at Obagi Medical. With over a decade in medical aesthetics and experience spanning startups, pharmaceuticals, and established brands, he focuses on category expansion, innovation strategy, and sustainable practice growth.

people.name: Julia Silva
people.role: Senior Director of Commercial Strategy , Obagi Medical
people.bio: Julia Silva is the Senior Director of Commercial Strategy at Obagi Medical. She has built her career across sales, marketing, and portfolio strategy within medical aesthetics, with a strong emphasis on operational alignment, patient outcomes, and go-to-market execution.

people.name: Lowinn Kibbey
people.bio: Lowinn Kibbey is an executive leader at Cynosure Lutronic, with over 20 years in healthcare, medical devices, and aesthetics. His background spans engineering, R&D, marketing, and general management, giving him a systems-level view of technology-driven practice differentiation.

people.name: Andrew Goldfein
people.role: VP of M&A , Alpha Aesthetics Partners
people.bio: Andrew Goldfein is the Vice President of New Partnerships at Alpha Aesthetics Partners, where he leads M&A and partnership strategy. With a background in investment banking and healthcare transactions, he evaluates growth opportunities through both financial discipline and operational fit.

people.name: Kat Fairchild
people.bio:
Kat Fairchild is a California-based content creator, entrepreneur, and mom who has built a loyal community by sharing real life, creativity, and beauty without pretense. Based in the Greater Sacramento area, Kat first gained visibility through YouTube, where she began posting lifestyle vlogs, beauty content, and honest glimpses into her everyday experiences. Her approachable style and genuine voice quickly resonated with audiences looking for something relatable rather than curated.

Beyond content creation, Kat is a business owner with a strong presence in the beauty industry. She is widely known for her work with Maskcara Beauty, where she helps women simplify their routines through education, color matching, and mentorship. What began as a love for beauty evolved into a career built around connection, confidence, and community. Kat is deeply involved in the Artist Program, where she supports and empowers others who want to grow their own businesses while staying rooted in real life.

Kat’s entrepreneurial path reflects her ability to recognize trends early, adapt creatively, and build sustainable ventures. In addition to her beauty work, she has expanded into brand collaborations, merchandise, and long-form digital storytelling, always maintaining a focus on authenticity over performance. Her audience is drawn not just to what she creates, but to how she shows up with warmth, humor, and honesty.

At her core, Kat is driven by people. Whether she is sharing a behind-the-scenes moment, talking about creativity, or mentoring others, her work centers on making space for individuality and growth. She continues to evolve as a creator and entrepreneur while staying grounded in the life she is building with her family, making her both relatable and inspiring to those who follow along.

‍

people.name: Austin Ryde
people.bio: Austin Ryde is a Los Angeles–based makeup artist and photographer working primarily in the beauty and fashion space. He collaborates with clients across editorial, brand, and creative projects, bringing a clean, modern aesthetic shaped by years of hands-on industry experience. Austin is known for his eye for detail, calm on-set presence, and ability to connect with people through both makeup and imagery.

people.name: Tiffany Ellison
people.role: Director of Surgical Patient Care, Esthetics Center
people.bio:
Tiffany Ellison is the host of Dear Tiffany, a lifestyle podcast dedicated to beauty, wellness, and personal growth for women in midlife and beyond. A former Mrs. California, Tiffany brings a unique blend of poise, curiosity, and real-world perspective to conversations about aging confidently, living intentionally, and embracing every season of womanhood.

With a lifelong passion for beauty, health, and self-development, Tiffany is especially drawn to the often-overlooked conversations surrounding menopause, hormonal health, and reinvention in midlife. Through Dear Tiffany, she creates a welcoming space for honest dialogue—blending expert insights, personal reflection, and thoughtful storytelling to help women feel informed, empowered, and inspired.

Known for her warm presence and genuine curiosity, Tiffany has a gift for making complex or sensitive topics feel accessible and human. Whether speaking with industry experts, founders, or women navigating their own life transitions, her goal is always the same: to encourage confidence, clarity, and a more beautiful way of living—inside and out.

Tiffany lives with her husband and family and believes that growth doesn’t end at a certain age—it simply takes on new meaning.

‍

people.name: Dr. Jennifer Linder
people.role: Founder and Chief Medical Officer, Linder Health
people.bio: Jennifer Linder, MD, FAAD, FACMS, is a board-certified dermatologist and a fellowship-trained skin cancer surgeon who holds micrographic technique with a medical license in Hawaii, California, Wyoming, and Arizona. Prior founding and served as Chief Scientific Officer for PCA Skin, guiding product development and clinical trials for the company. She is a published author and renowned speaker on dermatology, aesthetics, and cosmetic procedures. The Washington University Medical School–trained surgical internship at the University of Pennsylvania, followed by a three-year dermatology residency at Thomas Jefferson University in Philadelphia. She formerly held a clinical faculty position in the Department of Dermatology at the University of California, San Francisco, instructing other dermatologists in skin cancer surgery and the use of cosmetic injectables. Dr. Linder pursues her art, nature, and women’s rights by being an active business leader and mentor to her colleagues.

people.name: Leslie Fletcher
people.role: Aesthetic Nurse Practitioner/ Author/ Entrepreneur/ Educationist/Speaker Trainer Allergan, InjectAbility
people.bio:
Leslie is a highly respected aesthetic nurse practitioner with over 25 years of experience.  She founded her Los Angeles clinic in 2010. InjectAbility® Clinic has been ranked in the top 0.05% of the nation for use of neuromodulators and dermal fillers and was named one of Inc. 5000 fastest growing of all companies in the US.

Another part of Leslie’s work is her training expertise. She is an international speaker, author, and highly sought-after trainer who executes nearly 200 trainings per year.  Leslie has been Allergan’s number one utilized trainer the last 4 years in a row and she’s also one of 7 US Complication Consultants for Allergan, covering the country’s injectable complications. Some of her top courses through the InjectAbility® Institute include her patented filler technique, ArqueDerma® Lift and her 75 Obscure Uses for Toxin course, licensing out MicroTox®, NasalTox®, TheraTox® and RegenAbility™. 

Aside from her expertise in innovative injection techniques, she is also viewed as an expert in applying mental health into aesthetics, consultations and the patient experience, compliance/regulations in aesthetics, and complication management.

people.name: Dr. Sheila Barbarino
people.role: Founder & Medical Director, Barbarino Surgical Arts
people.bio:
Sheila Barbarino, MD, FAAO, FAACS, FACS, a true star in the world of aesthetics and an industry trailblazer! With numerous awards under her belt, Dr. Barbarino is a highly-skilled, results-driven cosmetic surgeon who has left her mark on the global stage as a world-renowned lecturer and key opinion and thought leader. She also has a passion for training, where she shares her knowledge of cutting-edge techniques for injectables, lasers, and aesthetic devices.Dr. Barbarino is also a prolific author, with over 15 articles published in prestigious peer-reviewed journals. Her dedication to research and her passion for the artful fusion of medicine and aesthetics make her a force to be reckoned with.Patients from near and far flock to her Austin and Los Angeles offices to experience her compassionate care and benefit from her years of clinical experience. Whether surgical or non-surgical, Dr. Barbarino's expertise shines through, helping her patients achieve the natural-looking facial and full body rejuvenation they've always dreamed of.

‍

people.name: Dr. Georgine Nanos
people.role: Founder & CEO at Kind Health Group, Kind Health Group
people.bio: Dr. Georgine Nanos, MD, MPH is a board-certified family physician and the founder and CEO of Kind Health Group and Kind TMS in Encinitas, California. With over 20 years of experience, she is nationally recognized for her expertise in preventive medicine, women’s health, and for pioneering The Kind One-Day TMS Protocol™ for mental health treatment. Dr. Nanos also leads one of San Diego’s most successful concierge primary care practices, known for its personalized, integrative approach to patient care.

people.name: Julie Bass Kaplan
people.role: Owner at Disappearing Act Laser & Skin Rejuvenation, Act Laser & Skin Rejuvenation
people.bio:
Julie Bass Kaplan is a nationally recognized aesthetic nurse specialist, injector, and educator with over two decades of experience in cosmetic medicine. After beginning her career in the operating room, Julie shifted her focus entirely to aesthetics in 1999, co-founding Disappearing Act Laser & Skin Rejuvenation alongside her husband, Dr. Jory Kaplan.

She is the founder of JBK Aesthetics Training Academy, where she trains providers nationwide in advanced injection techniques, anatomy, and safety. As a national trainer for Galderma’s GAIN program, faculty speaker for P.A.L.E.T.T.E. Resources, and regional trainer for CosmoFrance, Julie is dedicated to elevating clinical standards and promoting evidence-based, natural outcomes.

Her passion lies in teaching safe, artistic injection practices that empower medical professionals to blend science, skill, and artistry in every treatment.

‍

people.name: Dr. Shino Bay Aguilera
people.role: Cosmetic dermatologist, Shino Bay Cosmetic Dermatology & Laser Institute
people.bio: Dr. Shino Bay Aguilera is a renowned dermatologist, cosmetic surgeon, and pioneer in Functional Aesthetic Medicine. Known for his innovative, patient-centered approach, he specializes in bioregenerative techniques and anti-aging treatments that prioritize natural tissue replacement over synthetic fillers.Dr. Aguilera is the Course Director of the Tell All Tribune meeting and the visionary behind Genesis, where he fosters collaboration among key opinion leaders, scientists, and industry experts. He also serves as Co-Director of the Non-Surgical Track at Beauty Through Science, Europe’s premier aesthetic science meeting.A published author of numerous scientific articles, Dr. Aguilera is deeply committed to education, mentoring through residency and fellowship programs, and sharing his expertise globally. Widely regarded as a thought leader, he continues to shape the future of aesthetic medicine with his dedication to advancing science and promoting long-term well-being for his patients.

people.name: Doug Cartwright
people.bio: Doug Cartwright is the founder of Alchemy Sales Coaching and author of Holy Sh!t We’re Alive. A former top-producing sales rep, Doug has knocked on more than a quarter-million doors and trained thousands of high performers. Today, he blends those lessons with mindfulness, psychology, and neuroscience to help leaders regulate their state, rewrite limiting stories, and sell with integrity. Through his coaching, writing, and speaking, Doug equips entrepreneurs, executives, and sales teams with the tools to lead from alignment, presence, and clarity.

people.name: Andrew Horn
people.role: Executive Coach, Institute for Relational Leadership
people.bio: Andrew Horn is an executive coach, speaker, and founder of Relational Leadership. He works with CEOs, founders, and leadership teams to help them lead with clarity, integrity, and presence. Through coaching, retreats, and his Substack Relational Leadership, Andrew equips leaders with the tools to navigate challenges, inspire teams, and create meaningful impact.

people.name: Linda Rank
people.bio: Linda Rank is the founder of soul&beautyMEDx, a Southern California-based aesthetic practice focused on intentional, patient-centered care. A physician assistant with nearly 25 years of experience in dermatology and aesthetics, Linda is known for her strategic approach to med spa growth, emphasizing lean operations, high-touch service, and long-term brand building.

people.name: Araceli San Juan
people.bio: Araceli San Juan is the founder of Snatural Medspa in Scottsdale, Arizona. With a passion for injectables and a commitment to safe, credentialed care, she brings a personal and authentic approach to aesthetics. Her journey from patient to provider reflects her belief in confidence-building, grassroots growth, and doing business with heart.

people.name: MacKenzie Greenhill
people.bio: MacKenzie Greenhill is the manager of Refined Aesthetics in Minnesota, an Alpha Aesthetic Partners practice. With a background in both patient care and business operations, she brings a balanced, intentional approach to leadership. MacKenzie is passionate about building empowered teams, streamlining growth, and creating a med spa environment where both clients and staff thrive.

people.name: Bobbi Bullock
people.role: Owner & Operator, Bobbi Bullock Medical Esthetics
people.bio: Bobbi Bullock is a nurse practitioner and the founder of Bobbi Bullock Medical Esthetics, with locations in Boise and Meridian, Idaho. With 30 years of medical experience and over a decade focused on aesthetic injectables, she’s known for delivering natural results, leading with education, and creating a consistent, client-centered experience across her brand.

people.name: Ashley Carmen
people.bio: Ashley Carmen is the founder of Aiyana Atelier, an aesthetic clinic based in Alexandria, Virginia. With a background as a family nurse practitioner and ICU nurse, she brings a holistic, patient-first approach to medical aesthetics. Ashley is also a national trainer and mentor, known for blending natural results with deep clinical insight.

people.name: Illa Cox
people.bio: Illa Cox is the founder of Cox Medical Esthetics in Lodi, California. With a background as an emergency room nurse practitioner and professor, she brings a unique blend of clinical knowledge and patient-centered care to the aesthetics industry. Illa is passionate about education, ethical practice, and helping clients enhance their natural beauty through intentional, long-term treatment plans.

people.name: Katrina Long
people.bio: Katrina Long is the owner of Summit Medical Spa, a two-location med spa based in Utah. With a background in massage therapy and wellness, Katrina transitioned her practice from a day spa into a full-service med spa, focusing on personalized care, team development, and holistic aesthetic solutions. Her leadership is rooted in culture, education, and a deep commitment to serving both patients and providers.

people.name: Leslie Tracey
people.role: CEO & Managing Partner , Diamond Hands Media
people.bio: Leslie Tracey is the CEO and Managing Partner of Diamond Hands Media, a creative agency specializing in branding and video strategy for aesthetic businesses. She’s also the founder of Tracy Donovan, a boutique financial practice supporting med spa owners with succession planning and benefits. A dynamic speaker and Galderma business trainer, Leslie is known for helping leaders show up boldly and build brands that actually convert.

people.name: Dr. Ben Talei
people.role: Plastic Surgeon, Director, Beverly Hills Center for Facial Plastic and Laser Surgery
people.bio: Dr. Ben Talei is a double board-certified facial plastic and reconstructive surgeon based in Beverly Hills. Known for his groundbreaking work in lip aesthetics, he is the creator of the Cupid Lift™ and founder of Cupid Lips, the first all-lip aesthetic center. With advanced training from institutions like UCLA, Columbia, Cornell, and Memorial Sloan Kettering, Dr. Talei blends surgical precision with artistic innovation. He is also a passionate educator, international speaker, and the creator of the Cupid Compendium, a training platform for injectors and surgeons around the world.

people.name: Dr. Ciara Dimou
people.bio: Dr. Ciara Dimou is a board-certified Nurse Practitioner and Doctor of Nursing Practice. She is the founder of Vein Medi Spa and Vein Academy, where she combines medical expertise with a patient-first approach to aesthetics. Known for her leadership in the industry, Dr. Dimou is passionate about education, innovation, and helping others grow in the field of medical aesthetics.

people.name: Emily Anne Scalise
people.bio:
Emily Anne Scalise, M.A., is a psychology-trained business strategist, executive director of a premier boutique dermatology practice in Connecticut, and a consultant for leading aesthetic brands, including Galderma, L’Oréal, and SkinCeuticals. With a master’s degree in psychology from Columbia University, she specializes in values-based leadership, team development, and consumer psychology to help aesthetic businesses scale successfully.

A sought-after speaker and contributing editor for Practical Dermatology and Modern Aesthetics, Emily is passionate about building high-performing teams, optimizing workplace culture, and driving business growth through strategic leadership. She is also the author of the children's book “Why Mommy Works”, which explores the importance of purpose-driven careers for working parents.

people.name: Dr. Sam Patel
people.role: MD, MBA | Aesthetic & Wellness Consultant, Astra Culture
people.bio: Dr. Sam Patel is a physician, entrepreneur, and medical business consultant with an MD and MBA from Purdue University. He has built and scaled multiple aesthetic wellness clinics, pioneering cash-based medicine and patient-centered care. As the co-founder of Onyx Medical Partners and Live Wellness Lounge, Dr. Patel specializes in integrating wellness, aesthetics, and business strategy to create thriving practices. He also leads Astra Culture, a consulting firm that helps medical professionals optimize and expand their businesses. Passionate about innovation, AI in healthcare, and practice scalability, Dr. Patel is a sought-after speaker and industry mentor.

people.name: Yvonne Dellos
people.role: NP, Founder, Medical Aesthetic Art Institute
people.bio:
Dr. Yvonne Dellos is a board-certified nurse practitioner, entrepreneur, and educator dedicated to advancing the field of medical aesthetics. With a background in emergency medicine and a passion for innovation, she has built a reputation as a leader in patient safety, injector education, and business growth within the aesthetics industry.

As the founder of the Medical Aesthetic Art Institute, Yvonne has trained hundreds of practitioners, equipping them with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in aesthetics. She is also the creator of The Aesthetic Kit, a groundbreaking emergency preparedness tool designed to enhance safety protocols for injectors.

Beyond her clinical expertise, Yvonne is a mentor and speaker, known for her inspiring journey from humble beginnings to industry success. She is committed to empowering others by sharing her insights on resilience, business strategy, and personal development in aesthetics.

people.name: Alexa Costa
people.bio: Alexa Nichols Costa is a board-certified nurse practitioner and the CEO of LexRx, a leading esthetic injectables practice with multiple locations across Massachusetts. With a background in emergency medicine, plastic surgery, and esthetic injectables, Alexa has redefined industry standards through expert training and natural results. She co-founded Inject with Lex, a premier training platform, and pioneered the first university-backed esthetic injectables programs at Boston College and Columbia University. A sought-after speaker and educator, Alexa is dedicated to elevating esthetic medicine through education, mentorship, and innovation, shaping the next generation of skilled injectors.

people.name: Lori Robertson
people.bio: Lori Robertson, MS, FNP-C, is an internationally recognized expert in medical aesthetics with over 16 years of experience. As co-founder of The Aesthetic Immersion, she is passionate about elevating injector education through immersive hands-on training and evidence-based mentorship. Lori serves on the Global Advisory Board for Galderma Pharmaceuticals and is a sought-after speaker at prestigious aesthetic conferences worldwide. Before transitioning into aesthetics, she spent 19 years as a medical consultant and actress on General Hospital, blending her clinical expertise with entertainment. Known for her dedication to safety, ethics, and patient care, Lori continues to shape the future of the aesthetics industry.

people.name: Katie Martin
people.role: Vice President of Clinical Operations, Holden Timeless Beauty
people.bio:
Katie Martin, PA-C, is a board-certified Physician Assistant specializing in Medical Aesthetics since 2015. As Vice President of Clinical Operations at Holden Timeless Beauty, Katie excels in advanced injectable techniques, including neuromodulators, dermal fillers, and Sculptra, earning her the nickname “Sculptra Queen.” A nationally recognized educator, she is a sought-after GAIN trainer for Galderma and speaks at top industry conferences such as The Aesthetic Show and Vegas Cosmetic Surgery. With a passion for personalized patient care and empowering other injectors, Katie combines her clinical expertise with a dedication to advancing the aesthetics field through thoughtful education and leadership.

‍

people.name: Dr. Jean Carruthers
people.bio: Dr. Jean Carruthers is a globally renowned pioneer in aesthetic medicine, celebrated for co-discovering the cosmetic use of botulinum toxin type A, transforming it into the world’s most widely performed cosmetic procedure. With over three decades of experience, Dr. Carruthers is a Clinical Professor in the Department of Ophthalmology at the University of British Columbia and has authored more than 300 peer-reviewed publications, 70 book chapters, and nine textbooks. Her groundbreaking research alongside her husband, Dr. Alastair Carruthers, revolutionized the aesthetics industry and laid the foundation for modern anti-aging treatments. Dr. Carruthers is also a sought-after speaker and educator, often delivering keynote addresses at prestigious medical conferences. Recognized by major media outlets like The New York Times and Vogue, her work continues to shape the global conversation on cosmetic medicine. Dr. Carruthers remains passionate about advancing safe, effective practices and empowering the next generation of aesthetic professionals.

people.name: Natalie Dawson
people.bio: Natalie Dawson is a bestselling author, entrepreneur, and expert in scaling businesses through effective team-building and strategic operations. With a background from the London School of Economics, Natalie combines her financial and operational expertise to help companies align employees with business objectives, achieving extraordinary returns on investment. She co-founded Cardone Ventures in 2019 alongside Brandon Dawson and Grant Cardone, a management consulting and private equity firm that empowers business owners to reach their personal, professional, and financial goals. Under her leadership, Cardone Ventures has generated over $70 million in revenue within just three years, impacting clients across various industries. With more than $1 billion in businesses under management, Natalie’s insights on performance, efficiency, and team alignment are transformative. Her Amazon bestseller, TeamWork, outlines the strategies behind her success in building high-performance teams and creating growth-driven company cultures.

people.name: Tom van Eijk
people.role: Aesthetic Physician, Tom van Eijk Kliniek
people.bio:
Tom van Eijk is a renowned aesthetic physician based in Amsterdam and a global expert in non-surgical facial rejuvenation. He is best known for inventing the groundbreaking Fern Pattern Technique, a method that has transformed the way dermal fillers are used to achieve natural, subtle results. With over 20 years of experience in the field, Tom’s innovative techniques, including the Palma- and Lip Tenting methods, have earned him international recognition and the title of “The Lip Professor.” As a highly sought-after global trainer, Tom has educated thousands of practitioners worldwide, emphasizing the importance of precision, artistry, and patient safety. His approach focuses on enhancing facial features while maintaining the integrity of natural expressions. Tom continues to lead the aesthetic industry with his passion for advancing the field and mentoring the next generation of injectors.

‍

people.name: Harmony Samra
people.bio: Harmony Samra is the co-founder of Cosmetic Lane and a former celebrity blogger with experience at TMZ. Her unique background in celebrity culture and marketing allows her to craft relatable, trend-driven content for aesthetic practices. Harmony’s expertise in blending pop culture with medical aesthetics has helped Cosmetic Lane build a strong online community, educating patients and promoting aesthetic services with creative and engaging strategies.

people.name: Justin Mob
people.bio: Justin Mob is the co-founder of Cosmetic Lane, a leading marketing agency in the medical aesthetics industry. With a background in content creation and a passion for viral social media strategies, Justin helps aesthetic practices grow their online presence by crafting engaging, high-quality content. Since entering the industry in 2017, Justin has worked with top medical providers, utilizing his expertise to bridge the gap between aesthetic practices and patients.

people.name: Sharon Lechter
people.bio:
Sharon Lechter is a renowned entrepreneur, international speaker, best-selling author, and financial literacy expert. With over 35 years of experience as a licensed CPA and Chartered Global Management Accountant, Sharon has dedicated her career to helping people achieve financial independence and entrepreneurial success. She co-authored the global bestseller Rich Dad Poor Dad, which has transformed the financial lives of millions worldwide, and has written 14 other books in the Rich Dad series. In addition to her publishing success, Sharon has served as an advisor to two U.S. Presidents on financial literacy and has worked with major brands like Disney and Time Warner. She continues to lead her company, Pay Your Family First, which focuses on financial education through books, games, and curricula. Sharon’s commitment to empowering others to build wealth and create lasting legacies is central to her mission, and her impact has made her a highly sought-after mentor, educator, and thought leader.

‍

people.name: Henry Neely
people.bio:
Henry Neely is the Chief Financial Officer at Alpha Aesthetic Partners, where he plays a crucial role in driving financial strategy and supporting partners at every level. With a focus on using data and financial insights, Henry streamlines processes, enhances productivity, and helps partners maximize their clinic’s value. He is responsible for all finance-related matters at Alpha, working closely with CEO John Wheeler, the Thurston Group (PE Sponsor), partners, and the C-suite team to ensure sound decision-making. Known for his commitment to adding value, Henry thrives on helping his team develop, increasing partner profitability, and guiding shareholders toward a clear understanding of their return on investment.

‍

people.name: Chelsea Speer
people.bio: Chelsea Speer is the co-founder of Aesthetic Collective, a thriving med spa near Austin, Texas. A certified physician assistant, Chelsea has a background in pain management and anesthesia, bringing a diverse skill set to the aesthetic industry. Her bold, visionary approach helped drive Aesthetic Collective from a small start-up to a successful practice. Chelsea's hands-on, client-centered focus allows her to build strong patient relationships while delivering transformative results. With a talent for both injecting and business development, Chelsea's entrepreneurial spirit and medical expertise have made her a dynamic force in the aesthetics community.

people.name: Sara Browning
people.bio: Sara Browning is the co-founder of Aesthetic Collective, a med spa based outside of Austin, Texas. As a nurse anesthetist, Sara brings years of medical expertise to the aesthetic industry, combining her clinical skills with a passion for patient care. Known for her attention to detail and organizational prowess, Sara plays a key role in managing the operations and growth of Aesthetic Collective. Her commitment to providing high-quality treatments in a welcoming environment has helped her med spa thrive. Sara's ability to balance medical precision with business acumen has made her a respected leader in the field.

people.name: Erika Barry
people.bio: Erika Barry, co-founder of Aesthetic Intel, is a renowned aesthetic injector and trainer with over 300,000 followers on Instagram, where she’s widely known as Injector Bunny. With a passion for education, Erika travels the world speaking at industry conferences and training the next generation of injectors. Her expertise in aesthetic techniques and her engaging online presence have made her a leader in the field, blending clinical excellence with digital influence. Dedicated to fostering a supportive learning environment, Erika is committed to empowering fellow injectors through her hands-on approach and deep industry knowledge.

people.name: Marcus Curtis
people.bio: Marcus Curtis is a seasoned Branding and Marketing Expert with a passion for operational leadership and public speaking. Currently serving as the Business Development Manager at Aesthetic Record, Marcus excels in fostering partnership growth and organizing high-impact industry events. With a focus on faith, family, fitness, and fun, he brings a holistic approach to business, balancing professional success with personal fulfillment. Known for his ability to build strong relationships and drive results, Marcus is dedicated to helping brands grow while ensuring they stay true to their core values in an ever-evolving industry.

people.name: Julie Horne
people.role: Lip Specialist and International Trainer & Speaker, Julie Horne Academy
people.bio: Julie Horne, also known as "The Lip Queen," is a globally recognized aesthetic nurse specialist renowned for her expertise in lip enhancement. With over a decade of experience, Julie has revolutionized the field of aesthetic medicine with her signature lip injection technique, transforming the confidence and beauty of patients worldwide. She is highly sought after as both a practitioner and an educator, frequently leading masterclasses to share her knowledge and skill with fellow injectors. Julie’s journey in aesthetics is deeply personal. Her desire to improve her own appearance in her early twenties sparked her passion for helping others achieve their aesthetic goals. Despite facing life’s challenges, including a battle with stage 3 breast cancer, Julie’s resilience and dedication have only grown stronger. Today, she is an inspiring figure in the industry, known not just for her artistry, but also for her compassion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence.

people.name: Annie Robertson Hockey
people.bio: Annie Robertson Hockey is the President and Head of Consulting at SkyTail Group and Co-Founder & Director at Column National Association. With a strong background in financial technology and consulting, Annie brings a wealth of experience to the medical aesthetics industry. She is known for her data-driven approach to business growth, focusing on optimizing operations, enhancing patient retention, and scaling practices efficiently. Annie’s expertise lies in guiding businesses through transitions and helping them achieve sustainable success. Her passion for leadership and innovation drives her to create meaningful impact in every role she undertakes.

people.name: Waseem Garbia
people.bio:
Waseem Garbia, PA-C, Alpha Partner 009, is a seasoned professional with over 20 years of experience in the medical industry. Known as @unfilteredinjector on Instagram, Waseem is passionate about bringing honesty and authenticity to the field by showcasing real results and speaking openly. With a background spanning critical cardiology, general and plastic surgery, and emergency surgery, he has honed his expertise in skin and aesthetics. As the founder of Dontage Medical Aesthetics and Aesthetic Intel, Waseem has become a key figure in the industry, collaborating with top injectors and serving as an elite injectables trainer for world-renowned companies like Allergan and Revance. Dedicated to mentoring others, he shares his extensive knowledge of lasers, injectables, and clinical-grade cosmeceuticals. His passion for education and community-building in Medical Aesthetics drives him to help others build successful careers in the field.

‍

people.name: Charlie Winn
people.role: Co-Founder and Chief Revenue Officer, Liine
people.bio:
Charlie Winn is the Co-Founder and Chief Revenue Officer at Liine, where he has spent the last eight years revolutionizing phone performance management for the healthcare industry. Through Liine's all-in-one platform, Charlie helps medical practices convert more new patient calls into in-office consultations, driving growth and enhancing patient engagement. With a strong background in leadership, Charlie previously served as President & CEO at Paradigm 5, where he honed his expertise in business development and operational efficiency. His passion for leveraging technology to optimize business processes has made him a key player in transforming how medical practices manage and maximize their phone interactions.

‍

people.name: Peter Psillos
people.role: Co-Founder and Managing Director, Benchmark Medical Partners
people.bio: Peter Psillos is the Co-Founder and Managing Director of Benchmark Medical Partners, where he specializes in business development, strategic healthcare marketing, and growth consulting for private practices, hospitals, and institutions. With over 20 years of experience in the healthcare industry, Peter has a deep expertise in fee-for-service sectors such as aesthetics, plastic surgery, and women’s healthcare. His extensive background includes roles in medical device sales, key account management, and pharmaceutical-biotech sales, with a focus on working with plastic surgeons, dermatologists, and various specialists. At Benchmark Medical Partners, Peter leverages his vast experience to provide best-in-class marketing services and strategic consulting, helping medical businesses achieve sustainable growth and strong financial returns. Prior to founding BMP, Peter served as Managing Director of Business Development at Capital Practice Consulting, and as Strategic Accounts Manager for Galderma's Aesthetic & Corrective Business Unit.

people.name: Phil Sitter
people.bio: Phil Sitter is the CEO and founder of RepeatMD, a leading software company revolutionizing the med spa industry. With nearly four years at the helm, Phil has driven RepeatMD to achieve a nine-figure valuation and serve over 3,000 practices nationwide. Before venturing into the tech world, Phil honed his entrepreneurial skills in the restaurant industry as President of Egghaus Gourmet and King’s BierHaus, and CEO of KB Restaurant Group. He co-owned and presided over King’s Biergarten for a decade, turning it into a nationally acclaimed German restaurant. Phil's journey from restaurateur to tech innovator is marked by his commitment to discipline, strategic planning, and a passion for continuous learning. His leadership at RepeatMD is characterized by a deep understanding of small business challenges and a relentless drive to enhance client experiences and business growth.

people.name: Dr. Kian Karimi
people.role: Medical Director and Founder, Dr. Kian Nasal & Facial Plastic Surgery & Rejuva Medical Aesthetics
people.bio:
Kian Karimi, MD, FACS, is a renowned facial plastic and head and neck surgeon, double board-certified by the American Board of Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery and the American Board of Otolaryngology – Head & Neck Surgery. Based in Los Angeles, he leads a practice specializing in advanced facial plastic surgery and non-invasive procedures. In 2015, Dr. Kian founded Rejuva Medical Aesthetics in Brentwood, Los Angeles, and also treats patients at Pacific Eye & Ear, part of the Pacific Neuroscience Institute. He is recognized for pioneering non-invasive techniques and trains surgeons nationwide on PDO thread techniques, microcannula filler injections, and the use of autologous blood plasma for aesthetic and reconstructive purposes.

‍

people.name: Chris Balbi
people.role: Director of Marketing and Operations, Meesha Aesthetics
people.bio: Chris Balbi is the Director of Marketing and Operations at Meesha Aesthetics, where he has been a key player for the past 14 years. His extensive experience in the aesthetic industry is complemented by his role as Assistant to the Dean of the College of Performing Arts at The University of the Arts, a position he has held for a decade. Chris earned his Bachelor of Science in Human Resources Management and Services from Susquehanna University in 2012. Since 2014, he has also been the Social Media Coordinator for the Delaware Valley Legacy Fund, where he coordinates and promotes monthly networking events for the LGBT community in Center City Philadelphia, attracting an average attendance of 600 people.

people.name: Drew Leahy
people.bio: Drew Leahy, a distinguished figure in the field of content creation and marketing, is celebrated for his profound expertise in writing and generating copy. A professional writer for 13 years, Drew's educational journey began at Cal State Long Beach, where he pursued his passion for writing. His career has seen him contribute substantially to various organizations, notably as the founder and head of product at Patient Nectar, a company renowned for creating email campaigns for medical spas. He later joined Client Boost, serving as their head of marketing, and was an influential team member at Incredible Marketing, a medical aesthetics marketing company. Known for his concept of "thin versus thick content," Drew firmly believes that "good writing is good thinking," and advocates for writing as a means to foster clear thinking and understanding. An insider of the med spa industry, Drew is an invaluable contributor to discussions on content and copy.

people.name: Tedd Van Gorden
people.bio: Tedd Van Gorden is an esteemed expert in mergers and acquisitions (M&A) within the aesthetics industry. He currently plays a pivotal role at Skytale, a broker and investment banking firm dedicated to the aesthetics sector. With a rich background in corporate finance at Ziegler, Van Gorden has cultivated a deep understanding of the financial and strategic intricacies involved in M&A. His extensive experience in advisory roles has positioned him as a go-to authority in navigating the complexities of industry transactions. Van Gorden's insights are particularly valuable in today’s rapidly evolving aesthetic market, where he guides practices through the nuances of preparing and optimizing for transactions. His ability to analyze market trends and predict future movements makes him an invaluable resource for anyone looking to understand or participate in the M&A landscape of the medical aesthetics industry. Van Gorden’s expertise and foresight continue to shape the future of aesthetics M&A.

people.name: Dr. Edwin Williams
people.bio: Dr. Edwin Williams III, MD, FACS, is an eminent facial plastic surgeon with an illustrious career spanning over three decades since 1992. He is a distinguished member of Alpha Aesthetics Partners as Partner 006, bringing a wealth of experience and expertise to the team. Dual board-certified in Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery and Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery, Dr. Williams specializes in Facial Rejuvenation and Rhinoplasty. He is the founder of Williams Center Plastic Surgery Specialists, which has grown into a prominent 21,000 square foot facility employing over 75 staff members. His role as the primary shareholder and managing partner led to the significant expansion that included acquiring Saratoga Hair Transplant Center. Dr. Williams is nationally and internationally lauded, regularly presenting at key conferences. He has served over a decade on the American Academy of Facial Plastic Surgery's Board of Directors, including a term as President. His excellence in Facial Plastic Surgery has earned him the Castle Connelly Top Doctors award in New York from 2016 to 2019. As an active member of the Entrepreneur Organization, he contributes significantly to medical literature and is dedicated to teaching, mentoring resident doctors at Albany Medical Center. Holding an academic appointment as Clinical Professor in the Department of Surgery, Dr. Williams is also a recipient of the American Medical Association Physician Recognition Award, acknowledging his valuable contributions to medical education. His extensive experience and commitment to mentoring new physicians highlight his dedication to the advancement of facial plastic surgery.

people.name: Kay Durairaj, MD, FACS
people.role: Facial Plastic Surgeon and Industry Thought Leader, K. Kay Durairaj, MD, A Medical Corporation
people.bio: Dr. Kay Durairaj, MD, FACS, is a highly respected figure in the field of facial plastic surgery and aesthetics, renowned for her extensive experience and expertise. With a career spanning nearly two decades, Dr. Kay has established herself as a leading authority in the industry. She is a Key Opinion Leader for Galderma and Merz, sharing her knowledge and insights with professionals worldwide. Her proficiency extends beyond the operating room into the realms of AI technology and innovative marketing strategies in aesthetics, where she excels in integrating cutting-edge advancements with clinical practice. Dr. Kay's influence is further amplified through her substantial social media presence, particularly on Instagram, where she connects with a broad audience. Her educational contributions, including her own aesthetics training company, have made significant impacts on the industry. Dr. Kay's blend of medical skill, technological acumen, and business savvy marks her as a multifaceted professional in the dynamic world of aesthetic medicine.

people.name: Sarah Safa
people.bio: Sarah Safa is the powerhouse behind Refined Aesthetics Med Spa, located in the idyllic town of Leesburg, Virginia. As Partner 003 of Alpha Aesthetics Partners, she astounds with her exceptional ability to generate over $250,000 each month in injectable and laser revenue, placing her in an elite category of injectors. A seasoned physician assistant and national trainer for numerous major injectable companies, Sarah's expertise is recognized nationwide. Voted one of the top 100 best aesthetic injectors in America, she has significantly impacted the aesthetics industry through her comprehensive training programs. Having trained over six thousand medical providers, her wealth of knowledge and experience have established her as a leading authority in the field. Known for her proficiency as an injector and a trainer, Sarah's contributions to Alpha Aesthetics Partners and the wider industry are invaluable. We're incredibly fortunate to benefit from her profound insights and unparalleled acumen.

people.name: Amanda Holden, MD
people.bio: Amanda Holden, M.D., a key opinion leader (KOL) and owner of Holden Timeless Beauty, is renowned as an exceptional injector and a business powerhouse in the Southern California aesthetics industry. With five premier medical spa locations throughout the San Diego and North County areas, Dr. Holden leverages over 15 years of medical experience, including her tenure as an ER doctor and chief resident in her residency program, to provide top-tier services. Her dual expertise in business and medical fields allows her to contribute uniquely to industry conversations. Beyond managing her business, Dr. Holden serves as a KOL for leading companies like BTL, creators of Sculptra, Galderma, and UpNeeq. She is well-regarded for her insights as a KOL and her commendable work in building a noteworthy company. Join us as we delve into a compelling conversation with the accomplished Dr. Holden.

people.name: Christin Trujillo
people.bio: Christin Trujillo is not your typical Financial Consultant; she's a partner at Maven and a force to be reckoned with in the world of aesthetics, dental, healthcare practice, and small business financial management. With an eye for detail and a flair for making complex financials relatable and even enjoyable, Christin helps business owners not just survive, but thrive. Navigating growth, planning for the long term, or simply maintaining a steady pace—Christin offers tactical, practical advice that encourages forward momentum and problem-solving. Prior to joining Maven, her credentials included advising Fortune companies, where she drove multi-million dollar growth. This experience equips her to offer top-tier financial guidance to businesses without necessitating a full-time, in-house CFO. A fourth-generation small business owner, Christin understands the heart and soul of a business lies in its financial health—essential for supporting families and communities. Her passion for her clients' success is not just professional but deeply personal. When not in her financial guru mode, she switches to being a dedicated mom, often found enjoying nature walks with her family, cheering for the Kentucky Wildcats, or hunting for the next best brunch spot.

people.name: Caige Moore
people.bio: Caige Moore is the President and Partner at Studio III Marketing, a leading digital marketing agency with hubs in Los Angeles, Austin, and Florida. With extensive experience in developing innovative marketing strategies, Caige has played a pivotal role in shaping the agency's approach to custom web design, branding, and comprehensive digital marketing services.

people.name: Mary Beth Hagen
people.bio:
Mary Beth Hagen stands as a distinguished figure in the world of medical aesthetics, bringing over a decade and a half of rich experience to the table. Beginning her career in 2005, Mary Beth has contributed significantly to the industry through her roles at Medicis (now part of Galderma) and Allergan, where she excelled in sales, sales management, and product management for BOTOX® Cosmetic, among other responsibilities. Her deep commitment to the aesthetic community is further exemplified by her founding of Titan Aesthetic Recruiting, a company dedicated to recruiting, hiring, and training aesthetic injectors and professionals nationwide. Moreover, Mary Beth's passion for mentorship shines through in the Learners & Legacies mentoring meetings she established for budding injectors. As a lay representative on the Plastic Surgery Nursing Certification Board and a seasoned speaker, her influence extends across the industry, making her a trusted advisor and mentor to many in the field of aesthetics.

‍

people.name: Cody Williams
people.bio:
Cody Williams, residing in the Sacramento area, is a multifaceted professional known for his exceptional skills in negotiation and leadership. With a diverse career spanning real estate, investment, and pastoral work, Cody brings a unique blend of empathy, strategy, and insight to every endeavor. As a Realtor and investor, he has garnered respect for his ethical approach and ability to secure advantageous outcomes for all parties involved. Cody's dedication extends beyond his professional achievements; he is also a passionate investment coach, guiding individuals towards financial empowerment and success. His remarkable ability to connect with people, coupled with his vast network, positions him as a revered figure in the community. Cody's approach to negotiation, emphasizing the removal of ego to focus on mutual benefit, showcases his belief in creating value and fostering relationships. His contributions as a speaker and mentor further highlight his commitment to enriching lives and sharing his knowledge with others.

‍

people.name: Chunner Nyberg
people.bio: Chunner Nyberg is the Vice President of Sales at TouchMD, specializing in patient engagement solutions for the medical field. With a strong background in marketing and sales, Chunner has been instrumental in driving the company’s growth. He is also the CEO of 220 Sports.

people.name: Tyler Terry
people.bio: With over a decade of experience at TouchMD, Tyler is a seasoned expert in technology innovation and integration for Aesthetic Specialty Practices. He's worked in just about every department within the company from the mail room to successfully launching TouchMD in the MedSpa market in 2017, bringing on new vendor & consultant partners and now leading Nextech’s Med Spa initiative.

people.name: Virgil Ochoa
people.bio: Virgil Ochoa is a Member at Dykema, specializing in corporate practice of medicine regulations and extensive buy-sell experience. He provides counsel to medical professionals, including dentists and med spas, ensuring smooth transactions and prosperous new relationships. Virgil's expertise spans mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and corporate finance matters. He is also an accomplished international trade lawyer, advising on export controls, tariffs, and licensing. Virgil's dedication to building personal relationships and guiding clients through complex transitions highlights his commitment to their success.

people.name: Cary Deuber
people.bio: Cary Deuber is a prominent aesthetic nurse injector and reality TV personality, best known for her role on "Real Housewives of Dallas." As the founder of Lemmon Avenue, a medical aesthetic practice, Cary brings over two decades of experience in cosmetic nursing, specializing in innovative treatments like biostimulators to promote natural beauty enhancements. Married to plastic surgeon Dr. Mark Deuber, Cary integrates her medical expertise with her public persona to educate and inspire about aesthetic health. Her charismatic and straightforward nature has made her a beloved figure both on television and in the medical community.

people.name: Savannah Barineau
people.bio: Savannah Barineau is the Partner Development Lead at Social Practice, where she excels in building and nurturing relationships with clients in the aesthetics industry. With a strong background in marketing and client management, Savannah is dedicated to helping aesthetic practices grow through effective social media strategies. Her expertise and commitment to client success make her a valuable asset to the Social Practice team. Savannah's role involves understanding client needs, creating tailored solutions, and ensuring the delivery of exceptional results.

people.name: Mary Robb
people.bio: Mary Robb is the founder and CEO of Social Practice, a marketing agency that uses creative storytelling on social media to help aesthetic practices attract more patients. With nearly a decade of experience in advertising and marketing, Mary identified a gap in social media services for businesses. Her passion for storytelling and background in public relations drive her results-oriented approach, focusing on clients' vision, goals, target audience, and unique value. Mary is also a strong advocate for women's career development, continuously seeking opportunities to empower and support women in their professional journeys.

people.name: Bill Carpou
people.bio: Bill Carpou is the CEO of Octane, renowned for spearheading influential meetings on aesthetics and technology. Before Octane, he was an operating partner at Blackstone, managing significant revenue operations at RGIS, a key portfolio company. His vast experience spans over 18 years in senior roles at Profit Recovery Partners and IKON Office Solutions, focusing on revenue growth and mergers and acquisitions. A Villanova University alumnus with a degree in marketing, Carpou actively serves on several advisory boards and committees, including UC Irvine's Chief Executive Roundtable and Villanova's Presidents Advisory Council. He resides in Laguna Niguel, California.

people.name: Erica Crawford
people.bio: Erica Crawford, President at Influx Marketing, has extensive experience in public relations and digital marketing. She collaborates with hundreds of aesthetic medical providers to build and grow their practices. As a faculty speaker for various aesthetic organizations and conventions, Erica contributes to continuing medical education. She maintains strong industry relationships to stay updated on the latest innovations in aesthetics. Influx Marketing specializes in custom web design and comprehensive marketing for aesthetic medical practices under her leadership.

people.name: Jake Laban
people.role: President & Board Chair, Skin by Lovely Aesthetics, Inc.
people.bio: Jake Laban is the President and Board Chair of Skin by Lovely Aesthetics, Inc., a leading medical spa company renowned for specializing in injectables. Before his current role, Jake served as the U.S. Head of Aesthetic Portfolio Marketing at Allergan. With an MBA in Finance from Pepperdine University, Jake's expertise spans strategic leadership and operational efficiency in the aesthetics industry. He co-founded the first digital marketing agency for medical aesthetics, contributing significantly to the field's growth. Under his leadership, Skin by Lovely became the first medical aesthetic chain to offer employee ownership in the U.S. Jake's commitment to work-life balance and employee empowerment exemplifies his innovative approach to business and personal life, making him a respected leader and influencer in aesthetic medicine.

people.name: Kelly Pennington
people.bio:
Kelly Pennington is a seasoned professional in the aesthetics industry with over a decade of extensive experience. She recently founded Key Consulting, where she leverages her expertise to assist aesthetic practices in enhancing their operations and strategic growth. Prior to starting her consulting firm, Kelly served as the Vice President of Operations at Advanced MedAesthetic Partners (AMP). Her significant role at AMP followed a successful ten-year tenure at Galderma, where she excelled as an Area Sales Director. Kelly's deep industry knowledge and operational acumen make her a valued consultant and partner to med spas looking to thrive in the competitive aesthetics market.

‍

people.name: Reginald Rice, MD
people.role: Founder and Chief Medical Officer, Esthetics Center
people.bio: Dr. Reginald Rice is the Founder and Chief Medical Officer at Esthetics Center. He is a board-certified facial plastic and reconstructive surgeon with over 25 years of experience. Dr. Rice received his medical degree from Loma Linda University and completed advanced training in facial plastic surgery. He has a strong commitment to patient care, safety, and continuous learning, reflected in his numerous contributions to medical research and community service, including providing free medical care to children in Central and South America.

people.name: Michael Figueroa
people.bio: Michael Figueroa is the Chief Revenue Officer at Influx Marketing, bringing over several years of sales and marketing experience to the role. Known for his excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work both independently and as part of a team, Michael has a proven track record of meeting and exceeding goals. His leadership is marked by personal integrity, creativity, and flexibility. Michael is committed to continuous learning and process improvement, always striving to provide the best solutions for any given situation.

people.name: Aaron Purkeypile
people.bio: Aaron Purkeypile is a seasoned EOS Implementer with six years of experience helping companies harness the Entrepreneurial Operating System® to streamline operations and enhance team dynamics. As the visionary CEO at AMPT, Aaron has recently taken the helm to drive innovative leadership and strategic growth. His background includes a significant tenure as Director of Operations at Crossfit Lincoln, where he honed his skills in operational management and team development. Aaron's commitment to fostering frustration-free work environments and promoting core values has established him as a trusted advisor and leader in the entrepreneurial coaching industry.

people.name: Adam Daniells
people.bio: Adam Daniells is the CEO and Co-Founder of Influx Marketing, a leading firm specializing in innovative digital marketing solutions. With extensive experience in the industry, Adam has driven the company's growth by focusing on data-driven strategies and client success. Under his leadership, Influx Marketing has become renowned for its effective and creative marketing campaigns. Adam's expertise and commitment to excellence have positioned him as a prominent figure in the digital marketing landscape.

people.name: Tabitha Abraham
people.role: Co-Founder & President of Clinical Ops | Nurse Practitioner & Aesthetic Injector, Face Lab
people.bio: Tabitha Abraham is a Nurse Practitioner for a corporate start-up, leading a team of 35 nurse practitioners and servicing over 300 medical spas across the US. With a career as an aesthetic injector, she has a strong interest in clean beauty practices and skincare. Alongside her sister, she co-founded Face Lab to provide specialized treatments in an environment of overall wellness. Face Lab aims to instill confidence by optimizing facial features and enhancing natural beauty with a simplistic approach.

people.name: Jackie Spagnuolo
people.role: Aesthetic Nurse Practitioner and National Trainer & Speaker, Beauty Nurse NYC
people.bio: Jackie is a New York licensed Registered Nurse Practitioner. She has received her masters degree from Long Island University where she completed her degree as an adult nurse practitioner. She obtained her bachelors degree in nursing from Touro College School of Health Sciences and her certificate for aesthetics from Institute for Laser Medicine. With her experience of both art and healthcare she wanted to merge her passion for both. She offers a wide range of services from injections, facials, body contouring, hair restoration and more! At 28 years old she has been in the industry 4+ years, specializing in anti aging procedures for the face and body. Jackie takes an individualized approach to each of her clients to create a natural and subtle aesthetically pleasing look.

people.name: Max Baybak
people.role: Co-Founder of Influx Marketing & The Technology of Beauty Podcast | Public Speaker | Digital Marketing Strategist | Patient Acquisition for Cash-Pay Healthcare Practices, Influx Marketing
people.bio:
Creative marketing strategist with extensive experience in digital product management, search engine marketing, digital advertising, marketing automation, PR & corporate comms, social media and content marketing. Developed and implemented measurably successful strategies for diverse companies from start ups and small businesses to healthcare care institutions and fortune 500 firms.

‍

people.name: Janelle Cordtz
people.role: Director of Operations, Alpha Aesthetics Partners
people.bio: Janelle Cordtz, the Director of Operations at Alpha Aesthetics Partners, provides collaborative support to partners with a strong focus on partner obsession. She is dedicated to ensuring all operational aspects of their business function effectively, helping them achieve their goals and grow bottom-line revenue. Janelle embraces a people-first attitude, making sure culture is always the north star in everything they do. She shares weekly key business performance metrics, strategizes on ways to replicate wins, identifies opportunities for growth, and comes up with fun and creative solutions to ensure happy teams and clients. By strategically analyzing trends and working closely with each partner, Janelle determines the right levers to pull to achieve the desired results, always being there to celebrate wins and drive results through friendly competition.

people.name: Gary Price
people.bio: Gary Price is a seasoned executive with a distinguished career in operational leadership, currently serving as the Chief Operating Officer at Alpha Aesthetics Partners. With a rich history in the C-suite, Gary has shaped his expertise through pivotal roles, including COO at Love's Travel Stops and CEO of Corner Bakery. He is celebrated for his strategic acumen and deep understanding of corporate dynamics, particularly in scaling operations and enhancing organizational efficiency. Gary's leadership philosophy emphasizes the significance of understanding the rules of the game, which he believes is crucial for enjoying and excelling in one’s role. His approach to daily rituals and strategic planning is methodical, as demonstrated by his 20-20-20 morning routine, which includes meditation, cardio, and planning. This routine underscores his commitment to personal and professional excellence. Gary holds an influential presence in the business community, continually driving growth and fostering a culture of teamwork and accountability.

people.name: Ali Alden
people.bio:
Ali Alden, a distinguished Niche Strategist and StoryBrand Certified Guide since 2019, has carved a unique niche in helping small businesses capture the essence of their customer's thoughts and seamlessly integrate into ongoing conversations. Specializing in the trades, health and wellness, and professional services sectors, Ali's expertise lies in crafting StoryBrand messages that resonate deeply, hit harder, and clarify marketing messages like never before. Her mission is to empower small businesses to stand out in crowded markets, turning competition into profitability. Before establishing Ali Alden LLC, where she annually assists dozens of brands in clarifying their messaging, Ali contributed her skills to a MedSpa in Reno, Nevada. Her collaboration with John Wheeler at Esthetics Center showcases her ability to transform businesses through strategic storytelling, proving her commitment to making brands more relatable, understood, and successful.

‍

people.name: Rebekah Brannon
people.role: Director of Strategic Growth, Alpha Aesthetics Partners
people.bio:
Rebekah Brannon, the Director of Strategic Growth at Alpha Aesthetics Partners, provides invaluable assistance in growing the business through both organic and inorganic methods. She focuses on grassroots efforts, training and development, introducing new services, and pricing evaluations to drive organic growth. Additionally, Rebekah supports the expansion of Alpha through inorganic methods such as DeNovo clinics and acquisitions. Her strategic guidance ensures sustained growth and success for Alpha and its partners. Rebekah brings valuable experience from her previous roles at SkinSpirit and Esthetics Center, Alpha's first partner. Her background in these esteemed organizations equips her with the knowledge and skills to drive strategic growth at Alpha Aesthetics Partners, ensuring success for both the company and its partners.

‍

people.name: Lorenzo Neal
people.bio:
Lorenzo Neal, a distinguished 17-year NFL veteran, is celebrated as one of the greatest fullbacks in the history of professional football. With an academic foundation laid at Fresno State, where he earned his BA in Criminal Justice, Neal's NFL journey is marked by remarkable achievements, including the astonishing record of blocking for a 1,000-yard running back for 11 consecutive seasons. His storied career included impactful tenures with teams such as the New Orleans Saints, New York Jets, Tampa Bay Buccaneers, Tennessee Titans, Cincinnati Bengals, and notably, the San Diego Chargers, where he delivered the longest stint. Beyond the gridiron, Neal has made significant contributions to the sports industry as a Radio Talk Show Host at Intercom, a sideline commentator, TV Sports Analyst, and Sports Anchor for about a decade. Additionally, as the founder of Turf Medix, he showcases his entrepreneurial spirit by offering an eco-friendly lawn coloring system, demonstrating his commitment to sustainability and community welfare.

‍

people.name: Brian Colao
people.role: Member & Director of the Dental Service Organizations Industry Group, Dykema
people.bio: Brian Colao is an esteemed figure in the realm of healthcare legal services, renowned for his expertise in guiding dental and medical practice transactions. As Member & Director of the Dental Service Organizations Industry Group at Dykema, he stands at the forefront of the industry, offering unparalleled legal counsel to those navigating the complexities of selling their practices. With a career spanning almost 30 years, Brian has cemented his status as one of the most well-connected professionals in the field, embodying a wealth of knowledge on MSO/DSO organizations, private equity shifts, and strategic partnerships. His work at Dykema, the preeminent legal firm in medical and dental practice sales, underscores his dedication to ensuring clients achieve their business objectives with integrity and success. Beyond his legal acumen, Brian's insights into the evolving landscape of medical aesthetics and healthcare transactions make him a trusted advisor and thought leader in the industry.

people.name: Keimun Slaughter MD
people.bio: Dr. Keimun Slaughter is a distinguished facial plastic surgeon based in Albany, New York, working alongside Dr. Ed Williams at the Williams Center for Excellence. With a formidable educational background that includes studies at the University of Georgia, the University of North Carolina, and Duke University, Dr. Slaughter has established himself as an educational sage within the medical community. Renowned for his expertise in hair restoration, he has become one of the industry's rising stars, known for his deep understanding of Follicular Unit Extraction (FUE) versus strip hair transplantation methods. Beyond his technical skills, Dr. Slaughter is celebrated for his compassionate approach to patient care, addressing not just aesthetic concerns but also the broader implications of race and diversity within the aesthetics field. His commitment to work-life balance and his salt-of-the-earth personality make him a respected figure among peers and patients alike.

people.name: Josh Swearingen
people.role: Director of M&A, TUSK Practice Sales
people.bio:
Josh Swearingen stands at the forefront of the healthcare mergers and acquisitions field as a distinguished private equity advisor with Tusk.
