With a career spanning over two decades in healthcare, Josh has honed his expertise in leading sales and operations, positioning him as a pivotal figure in navigating the complex landscape of M&A. At Tusk, he specializes in advising and conducting due diligence for sellers, playing a crucial role in facilitating successful transactions across various healthcare sectors. Recently, Josh has shifted his focus towards the burgeoning med spa industry, applying his wealth of experience from dental and veterinary healthcare to med spas. His insights into the dynamics of ideal seller and buyer profiles, combined with his strategic approach to private equity, make Josh an invaluable resource for anyone looking to understand or engage in the M&A process within the healthcare sector.

‍

people.name: Bekah Wilkinson
people.bio: Bekah Wilkinson, the Creative Assistant at Alpha Aesthetics Partners, travels to meet every new partner and their team at their practice. She captures images that represent the owner, the team, the practice as a whole, and the incredible cities they are from. Additionally, Bekah handles additional shoots for location expansions or new locations. She also manages the Alpha Instagram page and handles podcast production for two podcasts in the Alpha Podcast Network, ensuring that the visual and audio content aligns with Alpha's brand and storytelling. She brings valuable experience from her previous role as the Communication Director for Vintage Grace Church. There, she handled all social media, photography, and communications, including newsletters, graphic design for church events, print, and signage. Bekah loves connecting with the team and partners, capturing them in their element. She thrives on being creative and appreciates the dynamic culture and pace of Alpha Aesthetics Partners. Bekah finds great satisfaction in contributing to the company's growth and direction, making her role both fulfilling and exciting.

people.name: jason Johnson
people.bio: Jason Johnson is a distinguished master photographer and a prominent innovator in the medical aesthetics industry. Best known as the creator and CEO of Simple Studios, Johnson has made a significant mark by addressing the longstanding challenge of before-and-after photography in aesthetics practices. With an eye for detail and a passion for perfection, he has developed a plug-and-play, high-tech solution that simplifies and enhances the documentation of aesthetic transformations. His expertise in photography, combined with a deep understanding of the unique needs of aesthetics professionals, positions him as a leading figure in elevating the standards of visual presentation in the industry. Johnson's visionary approach not only streamlines the photographic process but also empowers practitioners to showcase their work with the utmost professionalism, thereby transforming the way aesthetic results are captured and presented.

people.name: Sassy Fitzpatrick
people.bio:
Alexandra (Sassy) Fitzpatrick brings a vibrant blend of professionalism and charisma to her role as Guest Services Coordinator at Esthetics Center. With a keen eye for detail and a passion for customer service, Sassy ensures every client experience is seamless and memorable, making her an invaluable asset to the Esthetics Center team. Beyond her day-to-day responsibilities, Sassy is also the dynamic co-host of the Beauty Filter podcast. Her insightful commentary and engaging personality make her a favorite among listeners, as she explores the latest trends, tips, and stories in the world of beauty and aesthetics. With a dedication to excellence and a genuine love for her work, Sassy continues to inspire and connect with clients and listeners alike.

‍

people.name: Alexis Arnaz
people.bio:
Alexis Arnaz, the Clinic Manager at the Rocklin Esthetics Center and co-host of the Beauty Filter podcast, excels in her roles with a perfect blend of professionalism, kindness, and humor. Her passion for aesthetics ensures the clinic operates smoothly and provides an exceptional experience for clients. On the podcast, her great dry sense of humor and sharp insights captivate listeners as she explores the latest trends and stories in the medical aesthetics industry.

‍

people.name: Kevin Balzer
people.role: VP of Brand Strategy, Alpha Aesthetics Partners
people.bio:
Kevin Balzer, the VP of Brand Strategy at Alpha Aesthetics Partners, supports the content and strategy behind wherever and however the partner's brand is experienced, including print collateral, social media, websites, signage, and more. He plays a crucial role in launching partners and clinics, as well as informing marketing strategy for adding new services, providers, and locations. Kevin ensures that every touchpoint of the partner's brand is cohesive and impactful, driving growth and enhancing the overall brand experience. He also brings valuable experience from his previous role at Esthetics Center, Alpha's first partner. During his time there, he led a complete rebrand of the company, including rebuilding the website, conducting provider shoots and interviews, and more. 

‍

‍

people.name: Lauren Larocca
people.bio:
Lauren Larocca, Graphic Designer at Alpha Aesthetics Partners, handles all design-related tasks to maintain Alpha's brand identity and support partners. She creates partner-branded digital ads, print materials, social media posts for partner launches, speaking announcements, and more. Lauren also manages special announcements on LinkedIn and handles new partner press releases. Additionally, she works on the Beauty Filter podcast by posting on Instagram, designing posts and captions, and editing video teasers. Her role ensures that partners have professional and impactful visuals to support their success. Lauren has previously worked with notable companies such as the Sacramento Kings & Golden 1 Center and Esthetics Center, Alpha's first partner. Her experience at Esthetics Center has given her a strong background in supporting a med spa company, enhancing her ability to create targeted and effective designs for Alpha Aesthetics Partners. This diverse experience ensures that Alpha's brand identity is consistently engaging and professional.

‍

‍

people.name: Mitchell Outka
people.role: Digital Marketing Director, Alpha Aesthetics Partners
people.bio:
Mitchell Outka, the Digital Marketing Director at Alpha Aesthetics Partners, supports partners by implementing digital ads and software solutions that reveal opportunities and amplify marketing success. By leveraging data and analytics, he optimizes ad campaigns to ensure maximum ROI and utilizes automation tools to streamline sales and marketing follow-up, saving time and increasing efficiency. Additionally, Mitchell implements back-end structures to ensure first-time patients become loyal, repeat patients who refer Alpha to their friends and family. His role fosters long-term growth and success while maximizing the lifetime value of each patient, ensuring marketing efforts are trackable throughout the entire patient journey. Mitch brings valuable experience from his previous role at Esthetics Center, Alpha's first partner. His time at Esthetics Center has given him a deep understanding of the med spa industry, which he now leverages to optimize digital marketing efforts for Alpha Aesthetics Partners and ensure the success of all partners.

‍

people.name: Katrina Cancel
people.bio:
Katrina Cancel is the Social Media Manager at Esthetics Center, where she expertly manages the Instagram account, shooting and editing videos of providers from all three EC locations. Her dedication to staying up to date on trends and her knack for creating engaging content, have significantly enhanced the center’s online presence. Additionally, Katrina manages the EC influencer program, which she has successfully grown to include over 30 local influencers. Her creativity, strategic vision, and passion for aesthetics make her an invaluable asset to the Esthetics Center team.

‍

people.name: John Wheeler
people.bio: John Wheeler, the Chief Executive Officer of Alpha Aesthetics Partners, is dedicated to partner obsession, making it his top priority and motivation each day. He focuses on ensuring the business operates smoothly and that partners have the best experience possible. In his role, John meets with each partner monthly for a 360-degree check-in, working to build and maintain Alpha's vibrant culture. He strives to nurture the amazing and fun tribe that is Alpha, ensuring a positive and collaborative environment for all. John brings a unique and diverse background to his role as Chief Executive Officer. He spent seven years as a pastor in the Seventh-Day Adventist Church before co-founding Esthetics Center. His varied experiences have equipped him with valuable insights and leadership skills, which he now applies to guiding Alpha Aesthetics Partners towards continued growth and success.
